clue.text: Violent offender reported after game

parts.note: violent means wild, as in a wild attack

indicators.note: reported signals that the word for an offender is heard rather than written

parts.note: an offender who breaks the rules is a fouler

explanation.surface: A news item: a violent criminal reported after some sporting match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after game' looks like a time phrase following the report, but it defines the answer: someone who goes after game birds, i.e. hunts them.
explanation.definitionFit: A hunter of wild ducks and geese pursues them as quarry, so he is literally out after game.

clue.text: Unit in joint exercise

indicators.note: in puts the unit's letter inside the word for joint

parts.note: a weld is a joint made by fusing metal
unit means one, written as the numeral I

explanation.surface: Something about a unit taking part in a joint military exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise power or influence is to wield it.

clue.text: Worship fellow Rugbeian in ritual of brotherly affection

parts.note: to worship is to love
East is Tom Brown's friend at Rugby School in Tom Brown's School Days

explanation.surface: Old boys of Rugby School joining in a ceremony of fellowship.
explanation.walkthrough: A Rugbeian is a pupil of Rugby School, an English boarding school; Harry East is Tom Brown's schoolfriend there in the Victorian novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Early Christians held an agape, a shared meal expressing fellowship among believers.

clue.text: Editor's advice for young readers' entertainment

definitions.text: Editor's advice for young readers' entertainment

parts.words: Editor's advice for young readers' entertainment
parts.note: an editor writes the leading article, so telling readers to follow it is advice; it is also a children's copying game

explanation.surface: An editor recommends something to amuse children.
explanation.walkthrough: A newspaper's editorial is its 'leader', so an editor could urge readers to follow it; the phrase is also a children's game of copying the one in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's party game has everyone copying the actions of the person at the front.

clue.text: Was about to mark one from the elks

indicators.note: about means the word was goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a pit is a small mark or scar on a surface
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone was about to brand one of a herd of elk.
explanation.definitionFit: The large North American deer is known there as the elk.

clue.text: International currency business run from S America

parts.note: the ecu was the European currency unit used before the euro
ado means fuss or business
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Global money operations managed from South America.
explanation.definitionFit: This Andean republic on the equator is a country of South America, standing for the continent by example.

clue.text: Fruit is unripe, green — like iron to start with

indicators.note: to start with tells us to take only the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A description of some fruit: unripe, green and as hard as iron at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is only a link between definition and wordplay; the heads of 'unripe, green, like, iron' give the name of a Jamaican citrus hybrid.
explanation.definitionFit: This knobbly Jamaican citrus, a cross of grapefruit and tangerine, is a kind of fruit.

clue.text: Vocal old woman character

indicators.note: vocal means the word is spoken, so we want something sounding like it

parts.note: gammer is an old rustic word for an old woman

explanation.surface: An outspoken elderly woman who is quite a character.
explanation.definitionFit: The third letter of the Greek alphabet is a written character.

clue.text: Semi-nude in Bellini composition can't be removed

indicators.note: composition means the letters are composed into a new order
semi means half, so only the second half of nude is taken

explanation.surface: A half-naked figure in a Bellini painting is a permanent fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Semi-' takes half of NUDE, the letters DE, which are shuffled with BELLINI by 'composition'; Bellini was a Venetian painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ink that is permanent cannot be erased or washed out.

clue.text: Misrepresentations produced by freelance pests

indicators.note: produced by means the letters of the two words are worked into something new

explanation.surface: Lies written by troublesome freelance journalists.
explanation.definitionFit: Deception by false claims to gain something is fraud by misleading statements.

clue.text: Gasbag not finished? Wrap up!

indicators.note: not finished means the word for the gasbag loses its final letter

parts.note: the gas-filled bag of a balloon or airship is called its envelope

explanation.surface: Two curt exclamations, as if telling a windbag to stop talking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gasbag' suggests a talkative person, but it is the technical name for the fabric bag of a balloon.
explanation.definitionFit: To surround something completely in a covering is to enclose or swathe it.

clue.text: Not hurt when husband left, but vulnerable

indicators.note: left means the husband's letter has gone away from the word for not hurt

parts.note: not hurt means unharmed

explanation.surface: Someone escaped injury when her husband walked out, but is now exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being without weapons leaves a person defenceless and open to attack.

clue.text: US poet really broke the ice

definitions.text: US poet really broke the ice

parts.words: US poet really broke the ice
parts.note: read the American poet Robert Frost as removed or thawed out: a past tense for having taken the frost off something, like ice in a freezer

explanation.surface: An American poet was the one who got the conversation going at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broke the ice' suggests easing social awkwardness; here it means literally thawed, and the poet's surname, Frost, sits in the middle of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Thawing frozen food or a freezer means melting the ice off it.

clue.text: Make car stop, causing delay

definitions.meaning: to make an engine cut out by mistake, as a learner driver does
to play for time or put off acting

explanation.surface: A driver stops the car by accident and holds everyone up.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine that cuts out has done this, and someone playing for time also does it.

clue.text: Here, almshouses are not all in the country

indicators.note: not all in means only part of the words is taken, the answer sitting inside them

explanation.surface: A remark that charity homes are not to be found everywhere in the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A kingdom is a country or domain under one ruler.

clue.text: Regulates hampers

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean limiting: keeping within bounds by rule, and impeding movement.

clue.text: The place to see a show of meadow-saffron?

definitions.text: The place to see a show of meadow-saffron?

parts.words: The place to see a show of meadow-saffron?
parts.note: meadow-saffron, the autumn crocus, flowers without leaves and is nicknamed naked ladies, so a display of them is a show of naked ladies

explanation.surface: A gardener asks where to go to view a display of autumn crocuses.
explanation.walkthrough: Meadow-saffron is popularly called 'naked ladies' because its flowers appear with no leaves; a venue showing naked ladies is a nightclub of a certain kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A venue where dancers undress on stage for an audience is a kind of nightclub.

clue.text: Eden's dormitory suburb?

parts.note: Genesis places Cain's place of exile east of Eden, and its name suggests sleep, like a dormitory town

explanation.surface: Asking where the commuters from Eden sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis Cain went to dwell east of Eden, in a place whose name is also a jokey phrase for sleep; a dormitory suburb is where commuters sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical region east of Eden doubles as a playful phrase for being asleep.

clue.text: For example, Ariel's little sea change?

indicators.note: a sea change is a transformation, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ariel, the spirit in The Tempest, sings of a sea change; is that a little one?
explanation.walkthrough: Ariel suggests Shakespeare's sprite from The Tempest, whose song mentions a sea change, but here it is a moon of Uranus.
explanation.definitionFit: Ariel is a moon of Uranus, and moons are bodies orbiting a planet.

clue.text: Ring round to one who recites in singsong manner

annotationWithheld.clue: Ring round to one who recites in singsong manner

clue.text: Leader of uneconomic area is involved in a Continental union

indicators.note: involved means the letters are tangled up together
leader of means take the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: The head of a struggling region joins a European union.
explanation.definitionFit: The landmass joining Europe and Asia is a union of two continents.

clue.text: Selector's vase, say, thar's used for storing the ashes

definitions.text: Selector's vase, say, thar's used for storing the ashes

parts.words: Selector's vase, say, thar's used for storing the ashes
parts.note: the machine that picks Premium Bond winners has a name sounding like urn-y, i.e. like an urn, the vessel that holds the cricket Ashes

explanation.surface: A cricket selector's vase is the one used for keeping the Ashes trophy.
explanation.walkthrough: The Premium Bond prize-number generator has a name which, said aloud, sounds like 'urny', and the Ashes, cricket's England-Australia trophy, are kept in a small urn.
explanation.definitionFit: The random number machine choosing Premium Bond prize winners is the selector in question.

clue.text: Maiden in difficulty with a dance

indicators.note: in means the maiden's letter is placed inside the word for difficulty

parts.note: rub means a difficulty, as in 'there's the rub'
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A young woman in trouble with a dance routine.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cuban ballroom style is a type of dance.

clue.text: Divine nourishment in Indo- China when climbing

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue means the word is read upwards

parts.note: Annam was a region in Indo-China, now part of Vietnam

explanation.surface: Sacred food found in Indo-China during a mountain ascent.
explanation.definitionFit: The food God sent the Israelites in the wilderness is heavenly sustenance.

clue.text: It's enough to make one a treble

definitions.text: It's enough to make one a treble

parts.words: It's enough to make one a treble
parts.note: a word meaning three times over, which is enough to turn one into three

explanation.surface: Something enough to give one a hat-trick or triple win.
explanation.definitionFit: Multiplying by three, or having three parts, means tripling.

clue.text: River bed is without rubbish

indicators.note: is without means the word for bed goes outside the river letter

parts.note: doss is slang for a rough bed or sleep

explanation.surface: A river bed lies empty of litter.
explanation.definitionFit: Scum from molten metal is waste matter, hence worthless stuff.

clue.text: Restaurant with its own cutlery

definitions.meaning: a works or school dining room
a boxed set of knives, forks and spoons

explanation.surface: A dining place that provides its own knives and forks.
explanation.definitionFit: A staff dining hall is one sense; a fitted case holding a full set of knives and forks is another.

clue.text: Inferior duck's lower part

parts.note: second means inferior, as in second-rate
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so the letter O

explanation.surface: The bottom half of an inferior duck.
explanation.walkthrough: In a piano duet the player taking the bass half is given the Italian name for 'second'.
explanation.definitionFit: In a piano duet the bass half is played by the second performer.

clue.text: Fake national emblem is without foundation

indicators.note: is without means the emblem loses the word for foundation

parts.note: the shamrock is Ireland's national emblem
rock is a firm foundation

explanation.surface: A claim that a country's symbol is a fake with no basis.
explanation.definitionFit: Something counterfeit or pretended is bogus.

clue.text: Waits outside anchorage to deliver bombardments

indicators.note: outside means the word for waits goes around the word for anchorage

parts.note: bides means waits, as in bide your time
roads, or roadstead, is a sheltered anchorage for ships

explanation.surface: A warship waits off a harbour before firing its guns.
explanation.definitionFit: A full salvo from one side of a warship is a volley of gunfire.
